scenario: Kai is a 35-year-old instructional designer at NC State who wants to integrate AI tools into teaching and learning environments. He aims to use Vibe Coding to develop interactive educational resources.
expectations: Education-centered examples of AI tool integration
Project templates adaptable to higher ed environments
Portfolio artifacts that demonstrate innovation in learning design

phases.title: Phase 1 | Awareness
actions: Learns about Vibe Coding through NC State’s faculty innovation newsletter.
Attends a digital learning conference discussing AI in education.
Talks with peers about building interactive OER resources.
pains: LMS tools limit creative design possibilities.
Lack of time or tech staff to experiment with custom solutions.

feelings.quote: I need to build—not just imagine—better learning tools.

opportunities: Feature internal NC State case studies from faculty using Vibe Coding.
Offer CEUs or credential badges recognized by professional networks.

phases.title: Phase 2 | Consideration
actions: Reviews the 6-week syllabus and focuses on accessibility and value-proof modules.
Confirms project alignment with his department’s digital learning goals.
Talks with the instructor about integrating course deliverables into ongoing initiatives.
pains: Uncertain if AI tools meet university accessibility standards.
Needs to show ROI to justify internal time investment.

feelings.quote: This could finally help our team prototype future learning systems.

opportunities: Provide sample educational prototypes from previous cohorts.
Emphasize the course’s open-standards approach for institutional use.

phases.title: Phase 3 | Enrollment
actions: Registers via NC State’s professional development portal.
Selects a project focused on interactive digital literacy modules.
Collaborates with peers in library and academic tech units.
pains: Time management challenges during academic term.
Anxiety about presenting technical work to colleagues.

feelings.quote: It’s refreshing to learn through experimentation.

opportunities: Offer part-time pacing or flexible submission options.
Provide coaching sessions focused on accessibility compliance.

phases.title: Phase 4 | Engagement
actions: Develops an AI-enhanced visualization tool for library instruction.
Completes the reliability and accessibility checklists.
Publishes a project page in NC State’s OER repository.
pains: Integration issues with institutional data systems.
Limited bandwidth for continued maintenance after course end.

feelings.quote: I’ve turned AI theory into practice—and into a reusable asset.

opportunities: Invite him to present at an NC State faculty AI showcase.
Provide follow-up support for scaling projects across departments.
